# FinanzBuddy 0.3.6

Bugfix and UX release from branch `bugfixes-0.3.6`: variable-cost detail overhaul, split titles, transfer styling, fixed-cost prognosis dismissal, dashboard fixes, stock/import improvements, and modal/icon polish.

## Variable costs

- **Detail view redesigned** around **periods** (calendar month or salary period from onboarding), not a monthly table
- Period **paginator** switches the whole view; gauge section kept at the top
- **Transaction list** for the selected period shows only the assigned share when a transaction is split
- **Manual actual** input at the bottom; empty = transaction sum as forecast/actual (unchanged behaviour)
- Removed the old **month overview** table from modal and route page
- Split assignment UI is **split-only** (no category search when splitting)
- Split ledger titles use **`Name (amount) / Name (amount)`** format in transactions and on the dashboard
- Fixed detail API query error (`Got 2, needed 1`) when loading variable cost detail

## Transactions & categories

- **Transfer icon and colour** can be changed when editing or converting to/from a transfer
- **Convert ledger ↔ transfer** commands (`convert_ledger_to_transfer`, `convert_transfer_to_ledger`, `update_transfer`)
- **Running subtotal** resets correctly when sort or filter changes on the Transactions page
- Buy-list **forecasts hidden** when filtering to a sub-account (All / main account only)
- Category split titles and labels respect multi-variable-cost splits

## Fixed costs

- **Dismiss prognosis** removes the linked ledger booking and records the occurrence as dismissed (no duplicate re-appearance)
- New `fixed_cost_dismissed_occurrences` table and filtering in forecast/preview/unified entries
- Bank import **UPDATE** path now sets `fixed_cost_id` on matched rows (not only INSERT)

## Dashboard

- **All-accounts income tile** includes prognostic income
- Split variable-cost expenses show the **full split title** on the dashboard (not just the primary category name)
- Running subtotal recomputation after sort changes

## Bank import

- Default export account is the **main account**
- Primary income append import linking via improved matching

## Stocks & crypto

- **BTC-EUR** (and related pairs) resolved for Yahoo/crypto quotes
- **Partial stock sale** no longer reduces purchase cost basis in the lot ledger
- Removed automatic **10-minute portfolio refresh loop**; refresh on app start and manual refresh only
- After buy/sell, detail page refreshes quotes and chart without full portfolio resync

## UI & modals

- **Uniform detail popup width** (960px bleed) for variable costs, fixed-cost history, budget pool history, buy-group detail
- **Nested popups** (split modals) are smaller and stay inside the parent frame
- Form modals use 680px width; split modals use compact nested sizing
- **Icon picker**: 18 everyday icons added (ticket, train, bus, shirt, cart, etc.) to fill three rows
- **Colour picker**: single row of 20 balanced hues (fewer white/black variants)
- **Developer log dock**: draggable via pointer events

## Backend

- Variable cost actuals/sums include **split table** amounts
- `delete_ledger_on_conn` extracted for reuse (dismiss prognosis, deletes)
- `list_fixed_cost_dismissed_occurrences`, `dismiss_fixed_cost_occurrence` commands
